verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a chat UI with no-code agents, a sandboxed code interpreter for running code, MCP client integrations such as file system access, and subagents named only by a page title. None of it documents supervising or embedding a real coding agent that clones a repository, edits files across it, and runs its tests. The code interpreter and MCP file access are adjacent features or building blocks, not this capability, so they earn no credit.
